On the left, R1 is connected to a carbon, and a double bond is drawn between this carbon and N; N is then connected to O. This O is connected downward to the right to the central carbon on the right. The imine carbon on the left is also connected by a single bond to the middle carbon, the middle carbon is connected downward to R2, and is connected to the right to the central carbon on the right. The central carbon on the right is connected to an O-H group and connected to an OR group; there are also curved arrows in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning count: Listing all non-hydrogen bonds from left to right according to the figure: 1 R1-C bond, 1 C=N bond, 1 N-O bond, 1 O-C bridge bond, 1 C-C bond from the imine carbon to the middle carbon, 1 middle C-R2 bond, 1 C-C bond from the middle carbon to the central carbon on the right, 1 C-O bond from the central carbon on the right to the O in OH, 1 C-O bond from the central carbon on the right to the O in OR, and 1 implicit O-R bond in OR. The O-H bond involves hydrogen and is excluded from counting. Therefore the total is 10.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Scan the structure left to right and list all non-H bonds: R1-C, C=N, N-O, O-C bridge, C-C from imine carbon to central carbon, central C-R2, central C-C to right-hand center, right-hand C-O of the OH group, right-hand C-O of the OR group, and the implicit O-R bond in OR. Exclude the O-H bond and ignore arrows. The count is 10.
